description: Erneuerbare Energien Landkreis Diepholz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.diepholz.de. Card service with the following topics: approved and requested biogas plants, approved and requested cogeneration plants, approved and requested wind turbines, approved solar parks, approved incident plants. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Renewable Energy District Diepholz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Energiequellen, Biogas, Solar, humanGeographicViewer, Solarkraftwerke, Windkraftanlagen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
